core_principles: Rugged and authoritative - visual language must convey 'Built Strong. Built Local. Built Right.'
High contrast over subtlety - dark heavy backgrounds contrasting with striking, fiery accent colors (representing sparks/heat).
Industrial scale spacing - generous padding and bold borders that mirror heavy steel construction.
Clear, actionable hierarchy for getting quotes and navigating services.
design_philosophy.target_audience: Contractors, construction firms, aggregate and mining sites, industrial companies.

background.description: Deep obsidian / Forge Black. Never pure black, slightly tinted with cool steel.

surface.description: Zinc scales for cards and containers representing brushed dark steel.

accent.description: Flame/Spark Orange for primary CTAs and Yellow for warning/safety indicators.

headings.styling: Uppercase for H1 and overlines, very tight tracking (tracking-tighter) for industrial weight.

body.styling: Clean, geometric sans for maximum legibility in technical specifications and dense dashboard areas.

spacing_and_layout.generous_spacing: Use p-8 to p-12 for content sections, py-20 to py-32 for major page sections.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grids: Use Mode A 'Tetris Grid' for the Services and Equipment Sales sections to create dynamic asymmetry. Never perfect uniform boxes.
spacing_and_layout.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use solid 1px or 2px borders (border-zinc-700) on cards to simulate welded panels.
spacing_and_layout.hero_overlay: Use bg-black/60 to ensure the stark white and spark orange text pops perfectly against industrial backgrounds.

surface_strategies.marketing_pages: Use 'Grid Borders' look. Dark surfaces, sharp 0px or 4px rounded corners (never pill-shaped unless for badges).
surface_strategies.dashboard: Use 'Technical Grid'. Clean lines, border-collapse styles, high density data, dark steel aesthetics.
surface_strategies.glassmorphism: Avoid soft glassmorphism. Use solid, opaque dark materials for dropdowns and modals to maintain the rugged feel.

components.buttons: Square or very slightly rounded (rounded-sm). Primary buttons MUST be Spark Orange (bg-orange-600 hover:bg-orange-500 text-white) with bold uppercase text.
components.cards: Dark zinc background (bg-zinc-900), subtle border (border-zinc-800), and a harsh shadow or no shadow. On hover, translate up and border turns orange.
components.inputs: Shadcn standard but customized to dark mode: bg-zinc-950 border-zinc-700 focus:ring-orange-500 focus:border-orange-500 text-white.
components.navigation: Sticky, solid background (bg-zinc-950/90 backdrop-blur-md), bottom border (border-zinc-800). Nav links bold and uppercase.
components.icons: Use lucide-react. Prefer industrial icons: Hammer, Wrench, HardHat, Flame, Tractor, Settings, ShieldCheck.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Harsh, immediate color swaps. No slow easing. Buttons should feel snappy and mechanical.
motion_and_interactions.scroll_animations: Use framer-motion for simple 'fade in and slide up' on major sections as user scrolls.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Fast, high-contrast spinners or linear progress bars in accent orange.

media.image_style: High contrast, dramatic lighting, gritty industrial feel. Use grayscale filters on hover states for dynamic effects.

testing.requirements: All interactive elements, buttons, nav links, forms, and admin features must have descriptive data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-quote-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Request a Quote' form using Shadcn Input, Textarea, and Select components (customized to dark mode).
Build an Admin Dashboard route (e.g., `/admin`) with a login screen and a table (Shadcn Table) listing quote requests.
Use custom Google Fonts (Clash Display for headings, Manrope for body) in your global CSS.
Construct the Services and Equipment sections using CSS Grid to create a 'bento box' layout, not just standard columns.
Ensure the Hero section has a dark gradient overlay so text remains perfectly legible against the sparks.
The footer should be heavily styled as 'industrial dark', using the dark_metal_texture if possible, with clear contact info.
